binaries.name: bdeinfo
binaries.why: Read a BitLocker volume header and every key protector on it, before any key is known.

binaries.name: bdemount
binaries.why: Expose an unlocked BitLocker volume as a file the toolkit can read.

binaries.name: dislocker
binaries.why: Unlock a BitLocker volume to a file with a recovery password, a key file, or no secret at all where a clear key is present.

binaries.name: cryptsetup
binaries.why: Dump a LUKS header, list its key slots, and open the volume when a key is known.

binaries.name: fvdeinfo
binaries.why: Read a FileVault volume's encryption metadata and its key material references.

binaries.name: john
binaries.why: Turn a header into a hash a password attempt can be made against, with the *2john helpers. Only where the operator has authorised it.

binaries.name: gpg
binaries.why: Read an OpenPGP message's packets (recipients, algorithms, the key it wants) with --list-packets before any key is known, import a private key found on the evidence, and decrypt once its passphrase is.
